title: The Border of the Free Port
author: Sable Montrose
blurb: Felix Underhill, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
